	var RedirectPWA = {
		supportPWA: false,

		init: function () {
			//this will prevent redirection to pwa for reschedule flow
			var rescId="";

				console.log('redirect stop')
				return false;
			}
			if (this.redirectPWAEnable==false) {
				return false;
			}
			var obj = this.urlToObj(location.href);
			if (obj.redirect && obj.redirect == 'no') {
				return false;
			}
			var source = this.redirectPWAParam;
			var supportPWA = this.isMobile() && this.supportPWA();
			RedirectPWA.supportPWA = supportPWA;
			if (supportPWA && PAGETYPE == 'FLIGHT_SRP') {

				window.location.href = '//www.yatra.com/pwa/flights/srp' + location.search + "&source=" + source+'&lob=flights&pageN=srp';
			}
		},
		setReferrer: function () {
			var referrer = document.referrer||'';
			/*will set cookie when referrer is outside of yatra*/
			if (referrer.indexOf('.yatra.com/') > -1) {
				return false;
			}
			var params = {
				cname: "yt_rc",
				cvalue: referrer,
				path: "/",
				domain: ".yatra.com"
			};
			if (referrer !== "") {
				document.cookie = [params.cname, "=", params.cvalue, "; path=" + params.path, "; domain=" + params.domain].join(
					"");
			}
		},
		urlToObj: function (url) {
			var arr = url.split("?");
			var isParams = url.indexOf("&");
			var obj = {};
			if (arr.length == 2 && isParams) {
				var objSpl = arr[1].split("&");
				for (var i in objSpl) {
					var a = objSpl[i].split("=");
					obj[a[0]] = a[1] || "";
				}
			}
			return obj;
		},
		isMobile: function () {
			return /Android|webOS|iPhone|iPod|BlackBerry|IEMobile|Opera Mini/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
		},
		supportPWA: function () {
			/*list of device not support PWA*/
			var _il = ['tablet', 'iPad', 'Windows Phone', 'SamsungBrowser'];
			var ret = true;
			for (var a in _il) {
				var _ua = navigator.userAgent;
				if (_ua.indexOf(_il[a]) !== -1) {
					ret = false;
					break;
				};
			};
			return ret;
		}

	};
	RedirectPWA.init();
</script>
